name: LLM-SRBench
description: Scientific equation discovery is a fundamental task in the history of scientific progress, enabling the derivation of laws governing natural phenomena. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have gained interest for this task due to their potential to leverage embedded scientific knowledge for hypothesis generation. However, evaluating the true discovery capabilities of these methods remains challenging, as existing benchmarks often rely on common equations that are susceptible to memorization by LLMs, leading to inflated performance metrics that do not reflect discovery.
reputation: A new benchmark proposed to test whether LLMs can genuinely discover scientific equations rather than recall memorized formulas.
notes: Potential contamination risk is a central concern because equation discovery tasks can be memorized; benchmark is designed to reduce overlap with common equations and better probe true generalization.
